Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa. Vasemm: Circuit diagram, not to scale. On the left is the Arduino board as a box with four connections on its right edge from top to bottom: 5V, A0, GND and pin 9. In the middle is the potentiometer: its upper end is connected to 5V and its lower end to GND, and the middle connection, the wiper, is connected to the A0 input. On the right is the servo as a box with three wires: red to 5V, brown or black to GND and the orange or yellow control wire to pin 9.
